description: This file defines the Api class within the Opencart\'s catalog model setting namespace, providing methods for API authentication, session management, and related database operations.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class for managing API authentication and sessions in Opencart.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates an API user based on username and key, returning their API info.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API details using a session token, verifying session and IP address.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Fetches all API sessions for a given API ID that are older than one hour.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes all API sessions for a given API ID that are older than one hour.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the last modified time of an API session to keep it alive.

methods.name: cleanSessions
methods.description: Deletes all API sessions older than one hour.
